definitions.explanation: The residence of the Emperor of Japan, located in central Tokyo on the former site of Edo Castle. The grounds include the palace buildings, gardens, and a wide moat. Also used generically to refer to any emperor's palace.

notes:
LOCATION:
The {皇居|こうきょ} sits on approximately 115 hectares in the heart of Tokyo, surrounded by moats and stone walls from the original Edo Castle. The {皇居|こうきょ} ⟦{周回|しゅうかい}→周回：14812_shuukai⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ (Imperial Palace loop, approximately 5 km) is one of Tokyo's most popular jogging routes.

ACCESS:
The main palace grounds are generally closed to the public, but the {東御苑|ひがしぎょえん} (East Gardens) are open for free visits. The inner grounds open to the public twice a year: on the Emperor's birthday and January 2nd (⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{参賀|さんが}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇居|こうきょ}⟦ランニング→ランニング：08018_ranningu⟧: running around the Imperial Palace
- {皇居|こうきょ}⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧: Imperial Palace vicinity
- {皇居|こうきょ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧: Imperial Palace front plaza
